notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Terra's first ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Declare Terra and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Terra, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Aurelia and Karmic Guide, adding {R}{R}
Resolve the Terra ability, choosing to pay {2} to trigger its reflexive ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield. 
Repeat each combat phase.
